# Accelerated Intelligence & Particle Physics Lab

> NTHU Department of Physics research group led by Yuan-Tang Chou, searching for beyond-the-Standard-Model physics at CERN's ATLAS experiment and building fast machine-learning systems — from FPGA triggers to cloud-scale inference — for collider physics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yuantangchou.com/): Lab overview, mission, and research highlights.
- [Research](https://yuantangchou.com/Research.html): Beyond-Standard-Model searches, Fast ML, ML reconstruction, foundation models, and Inference as a Service.
- [People](https://yuantangchou.com/People.html): PI Yuan-Tang Chou, current Ph.D./M.S./undergraduate researchers, and alumni.
- [Publications](https://yuantangchou.com/Publications.html): Journal publications, conference proceedings, and preprints.
- [News](https://yuantangchou.com/News.html): Papers, talks, posters, awards, and lab milestones.
- [Teaching](https://yuantangchou.com/Teaching.html): NTHU courses, prior teaching, and public tutorials.
- [Contact](https://yuantangchou.com/Contact.html): Email, phone, and office location.
- [Join](https://yuantangchou.com/Join.html): Open positions for postdocs, Ph.D./M.S. students, and undergraduates.
